name: h5b-v2-sched
hypothesis: H5b first attempt never moved off EDF: behaviour cloning on a constant action (accuracy 1.0) removed PPO exploration, so every checkpoint equalled EDF. With label smoothing 0.3 over valid candidates and entropy coefficient 0.01, PPO can explore and a learned UAV scheduler (offloading SHORTEST_FINISH, energy weight 4) may beat EDF.
threshold: Contribution (PLAN_HUONG_2_3.md 7.4): paired 95% CI of the DVR or marginal-energy difference vs SHORTEST_FINISH+EDF+NONE excludes 0 for the pooled seeds and for >= 4/5 seeds on evaluation-v21. Checkpoints chosen on validation only.
note: First attempt kept in target/rl/h5b and reported as a failed setup, not as a negative result.
